name: Linear G
summary: Lismore/Northern Rivers NSW ISP + web design/hosting (service from Jan 2000); bought Nornet (1999) and NRG, OMCS and Big River Internet (~2001), folding each brand into Linear G through 2009-18; still active (operated by MODULUX PTY LTD, ACN 108 797 566).

events.details: Internet service began Jan 2000 (site self-description); Lismore ISP + web design/hosting, also web host for local businesses. Earliest Wayback capture 25 Oct 2000.

refs.label: LinearG homepage: 'first began providing Internet services in January 2000'

events.details: Current operating company is Modulux Pty Ltd (ACN 108 797 566 / ABN 30 108 797 566), first registered with ASIC c. 2004, which trades as Linear G and is an APNIC member holding the group's address space. An earlier legal vehicle ran the brand 2000-04.

Folded the other brands of the Modulux/Nornet group into the Linear G brand as their websites were retired: NRG Internet (nrg.com.au from Jan 2009), OMCS, Gold Coast (omcs.com.au by 2009), Nornet (nor.com.au from Dec 2014) and Big River Internet (bri.net.au from Dec 2018). The site states 'Since 2010 Linear G has incorporated four other Northern Rivers Internet Service Providers, Nornet, Big River Internet, OMCS, and NRG Internet'; a 'Nornet Usage' billing portal remains.
